# From neurohackpain project

```{bash}
# Load conda env
source /scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/bin/activate_genodisc.sh

# Go to pipeline directory
cd /scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/repo/current/pipeline

# chr 22 only
snakemake \
  -n \
  --profile slurm \
  --configfile=tests/config_test.yaml \
  --use-conda \
  --conda-prefix /scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/conda-envs \
  run_package_results

# genome-wide
snakemake \
  -n \
  --profile slurm \
  --configfile=tests/config_test_full.yaml \
  --use-conda \
  --conda-prefix /scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/conda-envs \
  run_package_results

# MVP
/scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/bin/mvp_test_run.sh \
  /scratch/prj/neurohackpain/GenoDisc/test_data/COAD01.gz \
  CAD01 \
  "Coronary Artery Disease"
```
